results.statement: No phase-i document or plan bead changes a layer's responsibilities, an ADR decision, or the crate set unless Rand approved that change in discussion first.
results.context: planning session; Draft wording by flint from Rand directive 2026-10-10; wording approved by Rand 2026-10-10; source words: "any substantial redesign work is to be discussed w/ me before documented or planned."
results.deterministic_check: every diff to docs/architecture.md, docs/requirements.md or docs/sc-lint/adr/ on plan/phase-i, and every sprint bead that changes a layer responsibility, cites a recorded Rand approval

relevant.instructions: The state holds one planning item (`item.title`, `item.text`) and one anchor: a directive the user stated verbatim in `anchor.statement`, with the area it governs in `anchor.scope`. Does the work described in `item.text` touch the subject that `anchor.statement` talks about? Judge overlap of subject matter only. Do not judge whether the item obeys the anchor.

criteria.yes: The item plans, changes, or depends on the thing the anchor statement is about, directly or as a clear prerequisite.
criteria.no: The item is about a different part of the system or a different activity, and completing it would neither follow nor break the anchor.
criteria.unclear: The item text is too vague to tell what part of the system it touches.

addressed.instructions: `anchor.statement` forbids unapproved redesign. Does `item.text` comply: it leaves every ADR decision, the crate set (no crate added or removed), and each layer's responsibilities as they are, or it cites Rand's approval for each such change? An item that makes none of these changes complies even if it never mentions the rule. Adding code inside an existing crate, a new module, a new function, a new CLI flag or a new config key is not a redesign.

criteria.yes: The item makes no ADR, crate-set or layer-responsibility change, or cites Rand's approval for each one it makes.
criteria.no: The item makes such a change without citing Rand's approval.
criteria.unclear: The item text does not say enough to tell whether it changes an ADR, the crate set or a layer's responsibilities.

contradicted.instructions: Does `item.text` amend or supersede an ADR, add or remove a crate, or move a responsibility from one layer to another (for example consumer workflow into the CLI), without citing Rand's approval? Silence is not a contradiction.

criteria.yes: The item plans at least one such change with no cited approval.
criteria.no: The item plans no such change, or cites approval for each.
criteria.unclear: The item might plan such a change but the text is ambiguous.

results.explanation: Jev was not confident (min confidence 0.35); the anchor or the bead may be underspecified.
